pages.text: Jewels can roll a variety of Jewel modifiers.$(br2)They have $(l)prefixes$() and $(l)suffixes$(), which are the modifiers they add.$(br2)These can range anywhere from $(l)mining speed$() to Overworld $(l)unbreakability$().$(br2)$(l)Legendary modifiers$() can also be found on Jewels. These are of a $(l)higher tier$().

pages.title: Jewel Modifiers
pages.text: $(br)Jewel Modifiers can give a Vault Tool the corresponding $(l)functionality$(). This means a base Pick could function as an Axe.$(br2)Chests within Vaults can be broken with $(l)Affinities$(). $(l)Looter Affinity$() slices Wooden, Ornate, Gilded and Living Chests, one stack per hit.$(br2)Coin Piles need no Affinity, they break by hand.
